store.versions_left_selected_one: The versions on the left, the selected one on the right. Without a choice the latest.
stores.texts_flows_written_history: Texts your flows have written — with a history, like the metric series. A review, a report, a log: what a flow produced stays here.
stores.no_storage_yet_comes: No storage yet. It comes into being the first time a flow puts something in.
killswitch.runs_end_here_cancelled: Runs end here as cancelled, visible in the operations view with the name of the step.
killswitch.step_does_nothing_flow: The step does nothing, the flow continues through the normal outlet.
accept_invite.no_invitation_token_addres: No invitation token in the address.
action_fields.0_off_the_flow_still_runs_: 0 = off. The flow still runs on every call, only the message stays away. Needed where the far side does not summarize by itself: a tracker repeats its alarm every few seconds while it is on.
action_fields.0_do_not_check_reported_on: 0 = do not check. Reported once per phase of silence; as soon as a value arrives again it starts over.
action_fields.off_the_flow_decides_for_i: Off: the flow decides for itself using tool.ok at a decision.
action_fields.the_list_comes_from_your_m: The list comes from your MCP servers (Settings, MCP servers).
action_fields.adding_and_removing_only_p: Adding and removing only pays off on multi select fields.
action_fields.devices_report_nonsense_wh: Devices report nonsense when they do not know something, and such values do not belong in the series (the tracker sends 127 % for unknown, for example).
action_fields.only_applies_when_the_seri: Only applies when the series is created. An existing one keeps its kind.
action_fields.applies_when_no_column_wit: Applies when no column with a matching name exists.
action_fields.appends_a_line_to_a_note_i: Appends a line to a note in the vault, creating it when it does not exist yet.
action_fields.runs_asynchronously_the_ou: Runs asynchronously; the exit is named after the result: merged, conflict, pr_open, no_git, push_failed — otherwise "resume".
action_fields.empty_the_agent_from_the_t: Empty = the agent from the trigger. Without an agent it is simply passed through.
action_fields.empty_the_person_s_answer_: Empty = the person's answer from the context (spam.entschieden).
action_fields.empty_means_now_unix_secon: Empty means now. Unix seconds or ISO time.
action_fields.leaving_it_empty_is_the_no: Leaving it empty is the normal case: everyone manages in their profile how they are reached. When the chosen channel is not on file there, the other one is used.
action_fields.empty_nobody_assigning_sta: Empty = nobody. Assigning starts the lifecycle.
action_fields.creates_the_subtasks_propo: Creates the subtasks proposed in the plan as child tickets (part 1 starts, the rest waits for its predecessor).
action_fields.creates_the_verdict_row_an: Creates the verdict row and asks the question in the messenger. Below the immediate threshold the case waits for the digest card.
action_fields.creates_a_new_ticket_in_th: Creates a new ticket (in the project of the flow unless stated otherwise).
action_fields.reads_project_and_ticket_s: Reads project and ticket settings into the context (project.*, issue.*) so decisions can test them.
action_fields.turns_the_mail_into_an_ass: Turns the mail into an assistant item, the thing a person approves.
action_fields.separate_several_by_comma_: Separate several by comma. {{templates}} from the context are allowed.
action_fields.reports_a_case_the_memory_: Reports a case the memory already settled, as a note rather than a question.
action_fields.reports_plan_approval_revi: Reports plan approval, review, errors and blocks (default: on).
action_fields.merges_the_ticket_branch_o: Merges the ticket branch or opens a pull request.
action_fields.name_in_the_secret_vault_a: Name in the secret vault, available in the call as {{secret}}.
action_fields.normally_a_report_without_: Normally a report without a value is not an error — a device also reports its state when it does not know a value right now.
action_fields.tickets_only_it_separates_: Tickets only, it separates plan approval from split approval among others.
action_fields.without_the_checkbox_nothi: Without the checkbox nothing happens when auto deploy is off for the project.
action_fields.classifies_the_incoming_ma: Classifies the incoming mail in house (category, urgency, redacted summary) and looks up the learned rule for the sender. Writes klasse.* into the context.
action_fields.the_path_may_come_from_the: The path may come from the context: that way each kind grows its own note without changing the flow.
action_fields.path_allowed_so_the_same_f: {{path}} allowed, so the same flow checks several series depending on the start context.
action_fields.tears_the_test_environment: Tears the test environment down (container, volumes, worktree, port).
action_fields.queues_the_assistant_run_f: Queues the assistant run (for items a learned rule already approved).
action_fields.calls_an_mcp_tool_mail_vau: Calls an MCP tool: mail, vault, documents, cloud storage, home automation.
action_fields.calls_a_free_url_for_a_far: Calls a free URL. For a far side you use again and again, create a destination instead.
action_fields.sends_the_approval_card_fo: Sends the approval card for the assistant item.
action_fields.sends_a_notification_the_b: Sends a notification: the bell always, outside on the channel of the person.
action_fields.key_of_the_series_same_key: Key of the series. Same key means same series.
action_fields.key_of_the_series_it_comes: Key of the series. It comes into being with its first point.
action_fields.commits_the_verdict_learns: Commits the verdict, learns from it and moves the mail (spam folder or back into the inbox).
action_fields.writes_a_number_into_a_ser: Writes a number into a series and reads off where it is heading.
action_fields.writes_a_comment_on_the_bo: Writes a comment on the bound ticket.
action_fields.writes_a_point_into_a_data: Writes a point into a data series — number, location or text. For sources that send data along the way; anything reporting continuously should use the reporting address.
action_fields.writes_values_into_the_flo: Writes values into the flow context (usable later as {{key}}).
action_fields.resets_the_cost_window_fro: Resets the cost window: from here the runaway brake only counts fresh runs. Belongs at every human approval.
action_fields.sets_the_state_of_the_arti: Sets the state of the artifact the flow hangs off, a ticket or hardware. The possible values come from the artifact registry.
action_fields.sets_a_custom_field_of_the: Sets a custom field of the artifact the flow hangs off. Which fields exist comes from the artifact registry (Administration, artifacts).
action_fields.looks_at_a_series_without_: Looks at a series without feeding it, and notices when it goes quiet.
action_fields.starts_the_test_environmen: Starts the test environment of the ticket.
action_fields.moves_the_ticket_into_a_bo: Moves the ticket into a board column.
action_fields.what_counts_as_the_same_me: What counts as the same message. Empty = this node on its own; with {{path}} you separate by device or kind.
action_fields.assigns_an_agent_to_the_ti: Assigns an agent to the ticket.
action_fields.value_the_series_runs_towa: Value the series runs towards, 0 means empty.
action_fields.values_may_contain_path_fr: Values may contain {{path}} from the context.
action_fields.how_early_to_warn_0_turns_: How early to warn. 0 turns the warning off; it warns once per refill, not on every value.
action_fields.how_far_back_the_line_read: How far back the line reads (default 30).
action_fields.created_when_it_does_not_e: Created when it does not exist yet.
action_fields.pulls_rules_the_local_mode: Pulls rules, the local model and the memory together into one verdict.
action_params.value_comes_context_clear: The value comes from the context. Clear it to pick one.
admin.active_users_can_log_in_right_away: Active users can log in right away, pending ones still need approval. Without a password the user cannot log in, without an email address there is no email login.
admin.run_python3_scripts_provision: Then run python3 scripts/provision_mcp.py on the host, which creates the group and the token and assigns them to the user.
admin.password_needs_least_8: The password needs at least 8 characters (or leave it empty).
admin.project_that_updates_the_running_t: Project that updates the running Traccoon stack
admin.logging_blocked_afterwards_running: Logging in is blocked afterwards; running sessions end with their token. Unlocking is possible at any time.
admin.applies_all_projects_changes: Applies to all projects. Changes take effect at once, no restart needed.

personnel_file.failed_stuck_loop_failed: Failed or stuck in the loop (failed + loop_exhausted), the cases where the role really did not deliver.
personnel_file.finished_successfully_fin: Finished successfully or a finished plan (success + planned). A plan waiting for approval is delivered work, not a failure.
personnel_file.run_hangs_question_permis: The run hangs on a question, a permission or an approval (blocked). That is not the agent's failure but a promise of ours that is still open.
personnel_file.no_reported_failure_old: No reported failure. Old data without a measured result counts neither as success nor as failure.
personnel_file.no_average_single_36: No average: a single 36 hour run would shift it so far that it says nothing about any real run.
personnel_file.no_tool_call_window: No tool call in the window.
personnel_file.least_one_item_no: At least one item has no price in the catalog (or predates it). The amount is a lower bound, the real one is higher.
personnel_file.population_behind_three_b: The population behind the three bars.
personnel_file.last_run_role_chosen: Last run of this role in the chosen window.
personnel_file.longest_run_window: The longest run in the window.
personnel_file.half_all_runs_faster: Half of all runs were faster than this.
personnel_file.still_running_without_ver: still running or without a verdict
personnel_file.runs_without_final_verdic: Runs without a final verdict, usually still running.
personnel_file.nine_ten_runs_faster: Nine out of ten runs were faster than this.
personnel_file.raw_run_states_server: The raw run states. The server builds the three bars above from them, this is what it counted.
personnel_file.passes_through_agent_loop: Passes through the agent loop (runs.iterations), how often the model was asked again. On average 6.9 here.
personnel_file.lines_event_stream_run: Lines in the event stream (run_steps): tool calls, messages, edits. On average 21.5 here, so quite a different thing from a round.

artifact_types_panel.may_one_item_carry_: May one item carry several values at once?

assistant_policies.no_rules_yet_choose: No rules yet. Choose "always …" when approving an incoming mail and a rule appears here.

board.to_done_only_through_set_to_done_o: To "done" only through "set to done" on the ticket, which stops the test environment and merges the branch.

provider_models_panel.which_provider_ser: Which provider serves which models. Prices are in USD per 1M tokens and drive the cost of each run, 0 means it counts for nothing (local models, for instance). Context is the largest window in tokens, and t/s is the measured output speed, which is exactly the reason to pick a local model, because its price is 0. Models that are switched off disappear from the agent editor but stay available for the accounting of old runs. "Fetch models" asks your endpoints, "Prices" pulls prices and context windows from models.dev, where local models do not appear and stay untouched, so you measure their t/s yourself.

action_fields.report_itself_hint: Off: this step only creates the verdict and provides the text ({{ spam.card_title }}, {{ spam.card_text }}) — sending it is done by a report node behind it, which one can switch off without losing the filing.
action_fields.dedupe_key_hint: The matter at hand (account:UID of a mail, say). Empty = the node itself, then a second attempt of the same flow does not assign twice.
action_fields.card_kind_hint: Decides which buttons the bot attaches (spam_auto = "recall", say). Empty = an ordinary report without buttons.
action_fields.wait_hint: On: the step stands still until the run is finished — only then can the flow work on with the answer.
action_fields.fulltext_keep_hint: Stored only when nothing is redacted — otherwise what the redaction protects against would lie right next to it.
action_fields.outcome_spam_card: Context afterwards: spam.verdict_id, spam.card_title, spam.card_text, spam.card_kind, spam.card_due.
action_fields.document_read_summary: Fetches the latest version of a store into the context — for flows that build on the last time.
action_fields.answer_summary: Defines what this run returns to its trigger (a waiting webhook reads exactly that).
action_fields.assistant_task_summary: Gives the personal assistant a free assignment — without a mail, without a ticket, without a project.
action_fields.ref_hint: What the buttons refer to: spam_verdict_id, assistant_task_id, issue_id or project_id.
action_fields.attachment_summary: Fetches the attachment of a mail into the context (base64) — for tools that expect a file.
action_fields.document_text_hint: What is put down. Empty text puts nothing down — an empty version would only displace a real one.
action_fields.answer_text_hint: Free text. For a structured answer leave this field empty and set fields below.
action_fields.run_result_key: Context key: {{ run.output }} is the text, {{ run.status }} says whether it worked.
action_fields.agent_run_summary: Lets an agent work and waits for its result — without a ticket, without an intake.
action_fields.attachment_index_hint: Leave empty: the attachment the button hangs on. A number picks a particular one.
action_fields.document_summary: Puts a text down in a store — with a history, like a measurement in its series.
action_fields.answer_fields_hint: Key → value, values with {{ path }}. An object here IS the body of the answer.
action_fields.attachment_context_hint: {{ attachment.base64 }} is the content afterwards, {{ attachment.filename }} the name.
action_fields.timeout_hint: 0 = the default of the engine. A question from the assistant can break the limit.
action_fields.attachment_size_hint: Anything larger is not fetched: the content stands in the context of the run. Default 25.
action_fields.job_pause_summary: Halts the schedule this run comes from — the reminder that stops.
action_fields.approval_on_off: On: the assignment waits in the inbox for your person. Off: it runs at once.
action_fields.script_path_hint: A file in the script directory of the server. Paths beyond it do not run.
action_fields.script_summary: Runs a stored script (only what lies in the allowed directory).
action_fields.assistant_result_key: Context key for the result: {{ assistant.output }} is the answer.
action_fields.mail_move_summary: Moves a mail into a folder — without a target into the archive of the account.
action_fields.outcome_job_pause: Context afterwards: unchanged. The schedule is halted (or runs again).
action_fields.intake_heading: Heading in the assistant inbox. Empty = the first line of the assignment.
action_fields.flag_on_off: On: set the flag. Off: take it away again (as unread, say).
action_fields.short_form_intake: A short form for the intake when the full text should not go there.
action_fields.what_should_happen: What is to happen to the matter when it does not stand in the assignment.
action_fields.off_only_kick_off: Off: only kick it off. Then no result stands in the context afterwards.
action_fields.empty_mail_uid: Empty = the mail from the trigger. {{ mail.uid }} does the same.
action_fields.what_agent_should_do: What the agent is to do. {{ path }} fetches values from the context.
action_fields.mail_goes_card_returns: The mail goes away without a question; the card carries the way back.
action_fields.empty_job_of_run: Empty = the job that started this run ({{ job.id }}).
action_fields.empty_account_archive: Empty = the archive of the account, pattern included ({year}, {month}).
action_fields.change_only_custom_map: Change only when the webhook uses a mapping of its own.
action_fields.who_executes: Who carries the assignment out. Empty = the personal assistant.
action_fields.assignment_hint: The assignment itself. {{ path }} fetches values from the context.
action_fields.mail_flag_summary: Marks a mail as read, important or answered.
action_fields.resume_job: On: let the job run again instead of halting it.
action_fields.store_key_hint: Key of the store. It comes into being on the first write.
action_fields.run_heading_hint: Heading of the run. Empty = the first line of the assignment.
action_fields.outcome_flag: Context afterwards: unchanged. Result: flag, on, uid.
action_fields.outcome_move: Context afterwards: unchanged. Result: moved, target.
action_fields.empty_first_heading: Empty = the first heading or line of the text.
action_fields.only_first_time: Needed only the first time, for the overview.
action_fields.who_works: Who works. Empty = the personal assistant.
action_fields.intake_sort: What the intake sorts by. Freely chosen.
